CPWD 
 
 Accredited Certification Body · IAF Member 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION 
 
 Certificate No: ORG-1004 Page 1 of 2 
 
 This is to certify that the management system of 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. 
 
 Salt Lake, Kolkata, India 
 
 has been assessed by this certification body and found to conform to the
 requirements of 
 
 CPWD Class I Registration 
 
 SCOPE OF REGISTRATION 
 
 Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) of infrastructure projects 
 including water supply, sewerage & drainage, roads & highways, bridges, 
 buildings, industrial structures, and related civil engineering works. 
 
 Initial Certification Date 2022-01-24 
 
 Valid Until 2028-12-16 
 Certification Body CPWD 
 
 IAF Accreditation Yes - IAF MLA Signatory 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CERT-004 Page 1 of 2

[TABLE]
Initial Certification Date | 2022-01-24
Valid Until | 2028-12-16
Certification Body | CPWD
IAF Accreditation | Yes - IAF MLA Signatory

SCHEDULE OF AUDITS 
 
 
 AUDIT TYPE DATE LEAD AUDITOR FINDINGS 
 Initial Certification 2022-01-24 Dr. R. Mehta 0 major, 2 minor NCs - closed
 
 Surveillance Audit 1 2024-03-15 Dr. R. Mehta 0 major, 1 minor NC - closed
 Surveillance Audit 2 2025-02-20 Mr. S. Kapoor 0 major, 0 minor NCs 
 
 Re-certification 2028-01-10 TBD Scheduled 
 
 CONDITIONS 
 
 1. This certificate remains the property of CPWD and must be returned on
 demand. 
 2. The certificate is valid only when the annual surveillance audit fees
 are paid and audits are conducted. 
 3. Any change in the scope of registration must be communicated to the
 certification body. 
 
 4. Use of the certificate in a misleading manner shall result in immediate
 suspension. 
 This certificate was issued in accordance with the procedures of CPWD and is subject to the terms
 and conditions of the certification agreement dated 2022-01-24. 
 
 
 
 Dr. R. Mehta 
 Principal Auditor 
 CPWD
